long_biography.plain_text:
Peter Bray's move into business ownership followed work in brand and product marketing. In 2014 he and his wife Claire began building a Chicago-area Massage Envy franchise operation. The venture grew from a handful of spas into a multi-market network, and he eventually sold its locations and development rights to private equity.

Bray Companies became the vehicle for six FedEx-contracted businesses. Three handled pickup and delivery in North Carolina; three operated linehaul routes in Arkansas and neighbouring Texas. He sold those transport interests by early 2023. His career thus spans consumer-service franchising and contracted logistics, with the two ventures built and exited in sequence rather than combined into one continuing operation.
